title: [Feature request] Send Dynamic Sensitivity "Autosens" value to AAPSClient
body:
When using Dynamic Sensitivity variant of "Autosens" the value isn't passed on to AAPSClient. This would be a nice improvement.

As you can see below, "Autosens in algorithm" is showing in AAPS, but not in AAPSClient. There is no way to know what this percentage is when using AAPSClient as per now.

| AAPS | AAPSClient |
|--------|--------|
| ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0e2c834-8ecd-4298-a887-9ac7e9c5cc71) | ![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7bf46e4b-2299-4692-99a2-6fd06e241d8a)|

comments.body: I can see it is present in devicestatus uploaded to NS as "sensitivityRatio", so there is one way to find it 😄
